in_marathi.name: Ruchir
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ruchir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is golden or radiant. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ruchih' which means 'to please' or 'to attract'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby boy.
